newsitem.title: USA: EDITEK to go ahead with annual meeting.
newsitem.headline: EDITEK to go ahead with annual meeting.

text.p: EDITEK Inc said on Thursday it would proceed with its annual meeting despite the lack of an agreement with preferred shareholders.
The company said the meeting had been rescheduled for December 19. The record date for determining shareholders eligible to vote at the meeting is November 8.

The meeting was originally scheduled for November 6. EDITEK postponed the gathering when it entered into negotiations with preferred shareholders to resolve lawsuits brought by certain of the holders. The suits resulted from the company's inability to issue common shares upon conversion of preferred shares.
EDITEK Chairman Harry McCoy said, "The company is continuing to negotiate with the preferred shareholders and we remain hopeful that a settlement can be reached.
"Nevertheless, the company cannot continue to defer the annual meeting. We must proceed with the meeting, whether or not a settlement has been achieved."
At the meeting, EDITEK said, shareholders will vote on a proposal to increase the number of authorized common shares.
